description: Device signing (#240, ADR-003 decision 14): let this server sign the account's commits again. Only once PLC names this server's repo key (com.atproto.identity.getRecommendedDidCredentials) as the DID's atproto key again, through a PLC update the person signs with their rotation key. Drops prepared commits. Idempotent.

main.description: Turn device signing off for the caller's account.

errors.name: AtprotoKeyNotServer
errors.description: PLC does not name this server's key as the DID's atproto key yet.
